verdicts.reason: A: the tilted orange can sits right on top of the TASTINGS/ALL AGES pills, the RSVP Free button and the URL line, which is a serious collision and makes the CTA look broken. The big circle is also recentred behind all the copy, so it no longer matches the original. B keeps the original's layout, has no collisions and keeps a clear hierarchy, but it's mostly a narrowed copy: the can sits loose to the right, the bottom quarter is empty dead space apart from the 'missing asset' placeholder box, and the pill text and URL are small.
